thread:
maya: Heads-up: Nebula Cloud marketplace CI flagged a regression with the pinned driver for CUDA 12.1 (current pin 525.85). Quant kernel failures on A100 for FP8 workloads reported by Nebula. @oscar-nebula

rahul: Can you paste the failing test logs or the error snippet?

maya: Error snippet from their run:
```
RuntimeError: cuLaunchKernel failed: invalid configuration
stack: .../llm/runtime/quant_kernels.cu:452
``` 
Also this is the marketplace pin for current image:
```
{
  "cuda": "12.1",
  "driver": "525.85",
  "rocm": null,
  "note": "pinned for marketplace image v2.3"
}
```

linh: Looks like an ABI/kernel mismatch. We've seen 525.90 fixes for similar symptoms (kernel layout changes). Likely safe to test.

sarah: Impact? How many customers? Is this urgent for marketplace listing?

maya: Nebula says two early customers, one hit the regression under heavy fp16/quant inference. They're requesting a hotfix; not a mass outage but high severity for them.

rahul: Proposed plan:
1) Canary with driver 525.90 + CUDA 12.1 on nebula-canary.
2) If green, publish marketplace image v2.3.1 with pin bumped to 525.90.
3) If issues, rollback and open escalations.
ETA: canary -> 2h, full push -> 4-6h if green.

maya: @oscar-nebula any constraints on Nebula side for timing?

oscar-nebula: We can accept patch release; will run staging tomorrow morning. Prefer minimal listing downtime.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: DRV-PIN-1973456789. Canary cluster: nebula-canary-3. Status: queued.

linh: Also recommend setting runtime env fallback to avoid experimental quant path during the roll: REDWOOD_QUANT_EXPERIMENTAL=0 (env var) as temporary mitigation.

sarah: Product note: update marketplace changelog & customer comms. Support will prepare template.

maya: Support: please draft customer email once we confirm.

support: Got it, drafting.

rahul: Ops runbook (short):
```
# canary steps
1. spin up nebula-canary-3
2. install driver 525.90
3. run perf/regression suite: ./ci/run_kernels --a100 --fp8
4. if failure -> revert to 525.85 and escalate to eng-runtime
```

linh: Starting canary now.

deploy-bot: canary update: nebula-canary-3 completed. Result: PASS. (2h)

maya: Canary green. Proceeding with image v2.3.1 push and listing update. I'll open PR with changelog.

sarah: Support comms ready. No external press; just partner/customer notice.

rahul: Uploaded signed driver package and tags. Will notify when marketplace build completes.

deploy-bot: marketplace image build: success. v2.3.1 published.

maya: Done. Notifying Nebula and the impacted customers. Thanks all for quick work. Please add postmortem note and add quant kernel ABI test to regression harness.

linh: Opening PR to add regression test now.

sarah: Post-action: add a short row in partnership driver's compatibility matrix and schedule quarterly sync with Nebula to avoid surprise pins. :calendar:

oscar-nebula: Appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll confirm downstream validation tomorrow.

maya: Closing thread, follow-ups in product tickets. :white_check_mark:
